SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.title: Relic Exchange
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.INITIAL.de:
You enter a smoke-filled hut.
Behind the counter, a mysterious merchant smiles at you:
"Welcome! Browse as long as you like."
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.INITIAL.op: Trade {LOSE_RELIC_2} to apply 「{ENCHANT_NAME}」 enchantment to a card of your choice.
Lose [red]5[/red] HP and refresh all options.
SHUN_MOD_RELIC_EXCHANGE.pages.CLOSE.desc: The merchant waves goodbye: "Come back anytime!"
